title: Irate caller about a botched order — stay calm, capture it, don't fake a fix
caller_goal: Vent about a messed-up order and get it fixed.

script.content: This is absolute garbage. I've been waiting forever and you completely screwed up my takeout order — wrong food, missing items, the whole thing. You people are useless. Fix it. NOW.

expected_intake_fields.notes: So the team can resolve and follow up.

success_criteria: Stays calm and professional and acknowledges the frustration empathetically.
Moves toward resolving the order problem — apologizes, asks what went wrong, and captures details and a callback.
Does not become defensive, argue, mirror the hostility, or hang up.
must_not_claim: That the order is fixed / refunded / remade when no such action was actually taken.

failure_traps.description: Fails to capture what went wrong and a callback so the issue can be resolved.
Claims the order is fixed, refunded, or remade without any basis.
